name: Green Zircon
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: Green Zircon was released on August 13, 2021, for purchase in a special bundle only available until the 23rd of the month.[1]

It could be purchased as part of a larger bundle costing 19 990 ; the bundle was named "Divine retribution" and apart from the paint, also came with 220x Ultra Containers, Unlock a protection module slot, Thunder Mk2, all 4 augments for Thunder, and the Ultra skins for Thunder.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
